capabilities: Two-way sync mapped vault folders with AgentWiki spaces
Preview and confirm pull/push changes before applying them
Recover interrupted sync transactions from a journal
Negotiate between sync protocol versions v3, v2 and legacy v1
Sync only images actually referenced by synced Markdown pages
extras: README is written in Chinese. The author explicitly warns that automated tests do not equal real desktop/mobile acceptance and that real-device and release-channel verification is still pending, so the plugin should not yet be treated as fully released.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to synchronize vault folders with AgentWiki spaces, including conflict handling and recovery of interrupted transfers.

relations.evidence: 将 Vault 映射目录与 AgentWiki Space 双向同步

summary: Mobile-compatible sync plugin that two-way synchronizes mapped vault folders with AgentWiki spaces through a preview-and-confirm sync center.
